selections.selection: Unknown is not zero. Supported YTD evaluation requires both explicit prior base and prior withheld amounts; each named adjustment requires an own, explicit, finite value. selections.selection: For an owning Prisma client, calculation uses the existing payroll transition helper: SERIALIZABLE transaction, at most three attempts for P2034/P2002, re-query idempotency on every attempt, return 409 after exhaustion, do not retry domain errors, redact unexpected internal errors. No external side effect is added to the retry callback. Current production caller audit: actions/payroll/payroll-control.actions.ts and prisma/disposable-business-workflows.ts both call calculatePayrollRun without an injected client, so both use the owning-client SERIALIZABLE/retry boundary. No additional production caller change is needed in this checkout. Future injected TransactionClient callers must establish isolation/retry explicitly; mocked callers are not database proof.
selections.limit: An injected TransactionClient inherits its caller transaction; caller owns isolation and retry. Same-day statutory membership, stale-history checks at approval/posting, real contention/rollback and uncertain-commit proof remain pending. This is not full ENG-04 completion.
